hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Compute the base count of adjacent equal pairs nums[i] == nums[i + 1] in the initial sequence.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Changing nums[i] can create new matches with its left neighbor nums[i - 1] and right neighbor nums[i + 1].

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Identify candidate positions where replacing nums[i] with its neighbor's value yields the maximum net gain.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass computes baseline matches and scans local replacement gains.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all possible values at all n positions takes quadratic or unbounded time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Determines local gain at index i by comparing with neighbors nums[i-1] and nums[i+1].
